name: Rail Mounted Gantry Crane (RMGC)
tagline: Built for port and rail terminal yard stacking with full automation capability
description: Safe Build Engineering's Rail Mounted Gantry Crane (RMGC) is a high performance crane engineered for port and rail terminal yard stacking operations. Featuring an anti-sway system with eight rope reeving, regenerative operation, electricity driven steering and full automation capability, it delivers maximum throughput with minimum energy consumption and maintenance cost.
features: Rail span up to 50 m and lifting height up to 25 m
Available in both cantilever and non-cantilever option
Anti-corrosive paint finish to protect from rust
High hoisting and trolley speed for fast operation
Anti-Sway System with Eight Rope Reeving

specs.Lifting Height: From 12.5 m (1 over 2) to 20 m (1 over 8)

sections.title: Advantages for Yard Stacking
content: Perfect material handling option for rail terminals as well as for port
Can be operated in different yard space areas — useful for increasing storage space
Ensures low emission rate and noise level during operation
Low maintenance cost with long service intervals
Low energy consumption keeps operation cost minimal
Anti-Sway System with Eight Rope Reeving for stable lifts

sections.title: Advantages by Design
content: Low spreader setting time for faster cycle rates
Maintains firmness of hoist and trolley position with fixed travel direction
Ensures steadiness of crane throughout operation
Eliminates the necessity of using extra machinery or ropes
Prevents head block and lowers unnecessary load from rope or empty container
Energy efficient mechanism throughout all drive systems
Electricity operated spreaders require minimal maintenance
Raises production rate in comparison with other existing designs

sections.title: Motors & Speed Control
sections.content: All drives are specially designed to ensure high rotational speed and high power requirements for increasing working life. All key parts have been procured from trustworthy European manufacturers. The speed control system features rigid construction, trouble free functioning and adjustable design — developed keeping the operational requirements of container cranes in mind. The plug-in interchangeable design ensures easy accessibility and its advanced mechanism helps reduce running cost by lowering the necessity of employing highly skilled operators.

sections.title: RMGC Design Highlights
content: Unique reeving system design prevents oscillation
Regenerative operation for reduction of load and working speed ensuring low energy consumption
Electricity driven steering for precise control
Well built structure suitable for automation applications
Optional DGPS auto steering and container positioning system available
Travel system directly controlled by its gearbox
Separate drives for trolley, hoist and travel sections eliminating side shift on spreader
Large service network all over India with on-location training support

sections.title: Available Options
content: Communication point with Terminal Operating System (TOS)
Festoon / energy chain system
Anti impact system
Container pathway and full automation of RMG
Container fixing arrangement
Facility for remote operation
